Approve a pending approval task and execute the original command.
Requires the current user to hold approval permission for the task's module and risk level.

Reject a pending approval task.
Requires the current user to hold approval permission for the task's module and risk level.

post:/api/v5/approval-tasks/{id}/recall.summary:
Recall (cancel) a pending approval task.
Only the original submitter can recall their own task.

post:/api/v5/approval-tasks/{id}/chase.summary:
Chase (re-notify) the approver of a pending approval task.
Only the original submitter can chase their own task.
Re-publishes a PendingNotificationEvent to remind the approver.

children.description: Running cumulative balance: sum of Profit + Commission + Storage up to this deal. Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: balance

children.description:
Total net profit across all deals (including Entry=IN commission/fee).
Formula: sum(Profit + Commission + Storage + Fee) for all deals.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: totalNetProfit

children.description:
Sum of all positive deal P&L contributions.
Formula: sum of (Profit + Commission + Storage + Fee) where result > 0, across all deals.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: grossProfit

children.description:
Sum of all negative deal P&L contributions (negative value).
Includes commission/fee charged on Entry=IN deals even when no realized profit yet.
Formula: sum of (Profit + Commission + Storage + Fee) where result < 0, across all deals.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: grossLoss

children.description:
How much is earned per unit lost. Values above 1 indicate a net-profitable strategy.
Formula: |GrossProfit| / |GrossLoss|. Returns 0 when GrossLoss is 0.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: profitFactor

children.description:
Statistical expected value — average P&L per closed trade.
Formula: TotalNetProfit / TotalTrades.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: expectedPayoff

children.description:
Maximum amount by which the running balance fell below the starting balance (0 baseline).
Formula: max(0, -(minimum running balance across all deals ordered by time)).
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: balanceDrawdownAbsolute

children.description:
Largest peak-to-trough drop in currency and its percentage at that peak.
Formula: maxDd = max(peak - balance); percent = maxDd / peak * 100 (100% when peak=0).
Format: "amount (percent%)" e.g. "0.30 (100.00%)"
children.name: balanceDrawdownMaximal

children.description:
Largest percentage drawdown from any peak, paired with its currency amount.
Formula: relPct = max(dd / peak * 100); amount = dd at that point.
Format: "percent% (amount)" e.g. "5.00% (0.30)"
children.name: balanceDrawdownRelative

children.description: Total number of closed trades (deals with Entry=OUT or Entry=INOUT only).
children.name: totalTrades

children.description:
Number of short (sell) closed trades and the percentage that were profitable.
Direction is based on the opening deal (Entry=IN) Action=SELL.
Won% is based on sum of ALL position deals' P&L.
Format: "count (wonPercent%)" e.g. "3 (66.67%)"
children.name: shortTrades

children.description:
Number of long (buy) closed trades and the percentage that were profitable.
Direction is based on the opening deal (Entry=IN) Action=BUY.
Won% is based on sum of ALL position deals' P&L.
Format: "count (wonPercent%)" e.g. "5 (80.00%)"
children.name: longTrades

children.description:
Number of profitable closed trades and their share of total trades.
Formula: closed trades where (Profit + Commission + Storage + Fee) > 0.
Format: "count (percent%)" e.g. "4 (80.00%)"
children.name: profitTrades

children.description:
Number of losing closed trades and their share of total trades.
Formula: closed trades where (Profit + Commission + Storage + Fee) <= 0.
Format: "count (percent%)" e.g. "1 (20.00%)"
children.name: lossTrades

children.description:
Highest net P&L achieved in a single closed trade.
Formula: max(Profit + Commission + Storage + Fee) across all closed trades.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: largestProfitTrade

children.description:
Lowest net P&L in a single closed trade (negative value).
Formula: min(Profit + Commission + Storage + Fee) across all closed trades.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: largestLossTrade

children.description:
Average net P&L of profitable closed trades.
Formula: sum(P&L of winning trades) / count of winning trades.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: averageProfitTrade

children.description:
Average net P&L of losing closed trades (negative value).
Formula: sum(P&L of losing trades) / count of losing trades.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: averageLossTrade

children.description:
Longest consecutive winning streak: trade count and total profit during that streak.
Formula: scan closed trade P&L in order; find the run of positives with the most trades.
Format: "count (profit)" e.g. "1 (2.07)"
children.name: maxConsecutiveWins

children.description:
Longest consecutive losing streak: trade count and total loss during that streak.
Formula: scan closed trade P&L in order; find the run of non-positives with the most trades.
Format: "count (loss)" e.g. "2 (-1.50)"
children.name: maxConsecutiveLosses

children.description:
Consecutive winning streak with the highest cumulative profit, and its trade count.
Formula: across all winning streaks, pick the one where sum(P&L) is largest.
Format: "profit (count)" e.g. "2.07 (1)"
children.name: maximalConsecutiveProfit

children.description:
Consecutive losing streak with the largest cumulative loss, and its trade count.
Formula: across all losing streaks, pick the one where sum(P&L) is smallest (most negative).
Format: "loss (count)" e.g. "-1.50 (2)"
children.name: maximalConsecutiveLoss

children.description:
Average length (in trades) of all consecutive winning streaks.
Formula: sum(streak lengths) / number of winning streaks.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: averageConsecutiveWins

children.description:
Average length (in trades) of all consecutive losing streaks.
Formula: sum(streak lengths) / number of losing streaks.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: averageConsecutiveLosses

children.description:
Measures how well the strategy recovers from its worst drawdown. Higher is better.
Formula: TotalNetProfit / BalanceDrawdownMaximal (currency amount). Returns 0 when drawdown is 0.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: recoveryFactor

children.description:
Risk-adjusted return metric. Higher values indicate a more consistent strategy.
Formula: mean(closed trade P&L) / stdDev(closed trade P&L). Returns 0 when stdDev is 0.
Formatted to 2 decimal places.
children.name: sharpeRatio

post:/api/v5/plugin-deploy-test/install.summary:
TEST: Copy a plugin version directory from S3 to the MT EC2 instance via SSM.
All EC2/region/role config is read from the Ec2ServerMaps table using ServerId.
Returns CommandId + InstanceId + AwsRegion — pass all three to /status.

parameters.description: CCP server ID — used to look up the EC2 mapping in the Ec2ServerMaps table.
parameters.name: serverId

parameters.description: CCP plugin ID — used to build the S3 prefix "plugins/{PluginId}/{PluginVersionId}/".
parameters.name: pluginId

post:/api/v5/plugin-deploy-test/uninstal.summary:
TEST: Delete a plugin file from the MT EC2 instance via SSM.
All EC2/region/role config is read from the Ec2ServerMaps table using ServerId.
Returns CommandId + InstanceId + AwsRegion — pass all three to /status.

parameters.description: CCP server ID — used to look up the EC2 mapping in the Ec2ServerMaps table.
parameters.name: serverId

parameters.description: Absolute path on the MT EC2 instance of the file to remove, e.g. "C:\MT5\Plugins\MyPlugin.dll".
parameters.name: destinationPath

get:/api/v5/plugin-deploy-test/diagnose.summary:
TEST: Diagnose SSM connectivity for a server's EC2 mapping.
Confirms the assumed AWS account (via STS GetCallerIdentity) and checks which CCP SSM documents exist.
Use this to troubleshoot InvalidDocument errors — it shows which documents are missing in the target account+region.

get:/api/v5/plugin-deploy-test/status.summary:
TEST: Poll the status of a previously sent SSM command.
Use the CommandId, InstanceId and AwsRegion values returned by /install or /uninstall.
Pass roleArn only if the original command was sent with AssumeRole (matches the map's CrossAccountRoleArn).

get:/api/v5/plugin-deploy-test/servers/{.summary:
On-demand MT service health check for a server.
Sends CCP-CheckServiceStatus via SSM and returns the Windows service status in real time.
Typical response time: 2-5 seconds (one SSM round-trip).
